048
049        public static void addFactorCreateIfNecessary(EventFactor factor, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
050                if (get() == null) {
051                        new TriTachyonCommerceRaiding(null, false);
052                }
053                if (get() != null) {
054                        get().addFactor(factor, dialog);
055                }
056        }
057        
058        public static TriTachyonCommerceRaiding get() {
059                return (TriTachyonCommerceRaiding) Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
060        }

062        
063        public TriTachyonCommerceRaiding(TextPanelAPI text, boolean withIntelNotification) {
064                super();
065                
066                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
067                
068                setup();
069                
070                // now that the event is fully constructed, add it and send notification
071                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(this, !withIntelNotification, text);
072        }
073        
074        protected void setup() {
075                factors.clear();
076                stages.clear();
077                
078                setMaxProgress(PROGRESS_MAX);
079                
080                addStage(Stage.START, 0);
081                addStage(Stage.SEND_MERC, PROGRESS_1, true, StageIconSize.MEDIUM);
082                addStage(Stage.SUCCESS, PROGRESS_MAX, true, StageIconSize.LARGE);
083                
084                // not actualy repeatable since no way to reduce progress
085                // but this will keep the icon and the stage description showing
086                //getDataFor(Stage.SEND_MERC).isRepeatable = false;
087                
088                addFactor(new TTCRCommerceRaidersDestroyedFactorHint());
089                addFactor(new TTCRTradeFleetsDestroyedFactorHint());
090                addFactor(new TTCRIndustryDisruptedFactorHint());
091                
092        }

110        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode, boolean isUpdate, 
111                                                                        Color tc, float initPad) {
112                
113                if (addEventFactorBulletPoints(info, mode, isUpdate, tc, initPad)) {
114                        return;
115                }
116                
117                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
118                if (isUpdate && getListInfoParam() instanceof EventStageData) {
119                        EventStageData esd = (EventStageData) getListInfoParam();
120                        if (esd.id == Stage.SEND_MERC) {
121                                info.addPara("Several bounty hunters were recently hired to eliminate you", tc, initPad);
122                        }
123                        if (esd.id == Stage.SUCCESS) {
124                                info.addPara("You've convinced Tri-Tachyon to stop attacking your interests", tc, initPad);
125                        }
126                        return;
127                }
128                
129        }

153        public FactionAPI getFaction() {
154                return Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.TRITACHYON);
155        }
156        
157        
158        public void addStageDesc(TooltipMakerAPI info, Object stageId, float initPad, boolean forTooltip) {
159                float opad = 10f;
160                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
161                
162                FactionAPI faction = getFaction();
163                Color tt = faction.getBaseUIColor();
164                
165                if (stageId == Stage.START) {
166                        LabelAPI label = info.addPara("The %s needs to be convinced that continued investment in "
167                                        + "acting against your interests is unprofitable in the long term. If you are "
168                                        + "able to send this message without becoming openly hostile - or smooth any ruffled feathers "
169                                        + "afterwards - this may even "
170                                        + "mark you as someone whose understanding of business realities makes them worth working with.",
171                                        initPad, tt, faction.getDisplayNameLong());
172                        label.setHighlight(faction.getDisplayNameLong(), "worth working with");
173                        label.setHighlightColors(tt,
174                                        Misc.getPositiveHighlightColor());
175                } else if (stageId == Stage.SUCCESS) {
176                        info.addPara("You've convinced the %s to stop attacking your interests.", initPad,
177                                        tt, faction.getDisplayNameLong());
178                } else if (stageId == Stage.SEND_MERC) {
179                        info.addPara("Several bounty hunters were recently hired to eliminate you. You are likely "
180                                        + "to encounter them in the coming months. Resolving the matter with Tri-Tachyon before then "
181                                        + "is unlikely to make a difference in this; a contract is a contract.", initPad);
182                }
183        }
184        
185        public TooltipCreator getStageTooltipImpl(Object stageId) {
186                final EventStageData esd = getDataFor(stageId);
187                
188                if (esd != null && EnumSet.of(Stage.SEND_MERC, Stage.SUCCESS).contains(esd.id)) {
189                        return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
190                                @Override
191                                public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
192                                        float opad = 10f;
193                                        
194                                        if (esd.id == Stage.SEND_MERC) {
195                                                tooltip.addTitle("Bounty posted");
196                                        } else if (esd.id == Stage.SUCCESS) {
197                                                tooltip.addTitle("Success!");
198                                        }
199
200                                        addStageDesc(tooltip, esd.id, opad, true);
201                                        
202                                        esd.addProgressReq(tooltip, opad);
203                                }
204                        };
205                }
206                
207                return null;
208        }

267        @Override
268        protected void notifyStageReached(EventStageData stage) {
269                //applyFleetEffects();
270                
271                if (stage.id == Stage.SEND_MERC) {
272                        sendBountyHunters();
273                }
274
275                if (stage.id == Stage.SUCCESS) {
276                        TriTachyonHostileActivityFactor.setPlayerCounterRaidedTriTach();
277                        endAfterDelay();
278                }
279        }

297        protected void sendBountyHunters() {
298                // wolfpack
299                {
300                        Random r = Misc.getRandom(random.nextLong(), 7);
301                        DelayedFleetEncounter e = new DelayedFleetEncounter(r, "TTCRBountyHunterWolfpack");
302                        e.setDelayVeryShort();
303                        //e.setDelayNone();
304                        e.setDoNotAbortWhenPlayerFleetTooStrong(); // small ships, few FP, but a strong fleet
305                        e.setLocationOuterSector(true, Factions.INDEPENDENT);
306                        e.beginCreate();
307                        e.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGE, FleetQuality.SMOD_3, Factions.MERCENARY, FleetTypes.MERC_BOUNTY_HUNTER, new Vector2f());
308                        e.triggerSetFleetMaxShipSize(1);
309                        e.triggerSetFleetDoctrineOther(5, 4);
310                        
311                        
312                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(r);
313                        picker.add("tempest_Attack", 10);
314                        picker.add("tempest_Attack", 10);
315                        picker.add("tempest_Attack", 10);
316                        picker.add("scarab_Experimental", 10);
317                        picker.add("scarab_Experimental", 10);
318                        picker.add("scarab_Experimental", 10);
319                        picker.add("hyperion_Attack", 10);
320                        picker.add("hyperion_Strike", 10);
321                        picker.add("omen_PD", 5);
322                        picker.add("omen_PD", 5);
323                        picker.add("monitor_Escort", 5);
324                        picker.add("monitor_Escort", 5);
325                        picker.add("shade_Assault", 5);
326                        picker.add("shade_Assault", 5);
327                        picker.add("afflictor_Strike", 5);
328                        picker.add("afflictor_Strike", 5);
329                        
330//                      for (ShipHullSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllShipHullSpecs()) {
331//                              if (spec.hasTag("merc") && spec.hasTag("wolfpack")) {
332//                                      List<String> variants = Global.getSettings().getHullIdToVariantListMap().get(spec.getHullId());
333//                                      for (String variantId : variants) {
334//                                              ShipVariantAPI v = Global.getSettings().getVariant(variantId);
335//                                              if (v.isGoalVariant() && v.isStockVariant()) {
336//                                                      picker.add(variantId);
337//                                              }
338//                                      }
339//                              }
340//                      }
341                        
342                        int add = 9;
343                        while (!picker.isEmpty() && add > 0) {
344                                e.triggerAddShips(picker.pickAndRemove());
345                                add--;
346                        }
347                        
348                        
349                
350                        e.triggerSetFleetMaxNumShips(14);
351                        e.triggerSetFleetDoctrineComp(5, 0, 0);
352                
353                        e.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.COORDINATED_MANEUVERS, 1);
354                        e.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.WOLFPACK_TACTICS, 1);
355                        e.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.ELECTRONIC_WARFARE, 1);
356                        e.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.FLUX_REGULATION, 1);
357                        e.triggerFleetAddCommanderSkill(Skills.TACTICAL_DRILLS, 1);
358                        e.triggerSetFleetOfficers(OfficerNum.MORE, OfficerQuality.UNUSUALLY_HIGH);
359                        
360                        e.triggerFleetMakeFaster(true, 0, true);
361                        
362                        e.triggerSetFleetFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
363                        e.triggerMakeNoRepImpact();

366                        e.triggerSetFleetGenericHailPermanent("TTCRBountyHunterHail");
367                        e.triggerSetFleetFlagPermanent("$ttcr_wolfpack");
368                        e.endCreate();
369                }
370                
371                // phase
372                {
373                        Random r = Misc.getRandom(random.nextLong(), 3);

375                        e.setDelayVeryShort();
